主要内容: The Walt Disney Company entered into a terms agreement with Citigroup Global Markets Inc. and Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. regarding the offer and sale of $350 million in 1.650% Notes Due 2019, $750 million in 2.300% Notes Due 2021, $1 billion in 3.000% Notes Due 2026, $500 million in 4.125% Global Notes Due 2044, and $400 million in Floating Rate Notes Due 2019. The 2044 Notes constitute an additional issuance of the $500 million aggregate principal amount of 2044 Notes issued on June 2, 2014. The 2019 Notes were offered at 99.866% of par, with net proceeds to the company at 99.666% of par. The 2021 Notes were offered at 99.903% of par, with net proceeds to the company at 99.553% of par. The 2026 Notes were offered at 99.600% of par, with net proceeds to the company at 99.150% of par. The 2044 Notes were offered at 100.884% of par, with net proceeds to the company at 100.534% of par. The financing activities are part of the company's broader capital structure management and funding strategies for its entertainment operations and future projects.
